verdict.rationale: GitBook documents Auto translations to keep docs current in multiple languages with little manual effort [gitbook-docs-41]. Site customization can match the published UI to the content's language [gitbook-docs-47]. Content variants offer a plausible way to serve per-language versions of a site [gitbook-docs-20], and the co-founder notes long-standing internationalisation support [gitbook-comm-7]. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that navigation, section and group labels are translated per language, detail on how variants work for language switching, and independent hands-on corroboration of the translation workflow.
